bundle.description: Zip of the agent folder (spec.yaml, instructions.md, skills/, subagents/) with symlinks dereferenced.

gitCommitSha.description: Optional Git commit SHA to associate with this import.

gitAuthorId.description: Optional VCS commit author ID to associate with this import.

commitMessage.description: Optional commit message for the imported version.

syncMode.description: Whether the imported version is staged (saved without updating the live version) or published directly to the live version.
syncMode.title: ImportAgentSyncMode

isDraft.description: When true, validates and stores a draft preview without publishing (used for PR preview links). Takes precedence over `syncMode`: when `isDraft` is true, `syncMode` is ignored.
